description: This Java class defines an Android Activity named LiveButton that demonstrates button animations with anticipation and follow-through effects using interpolators. It sets up a Button, applies scaling animations when touched, and uses different interpolators for pressing and releasing actions.

classes.name: LiveButton
classes.description: An Android Activity that demonstrates button animations with anticipation and follow-through effects using interpolators.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and attaches a touch listener to the button that triggers scale animations with different interpolators based on touch events.
